Senses.Explanation: Letting the withered remain withered refuses manipulative improvement of the presented condition. Gao Shami uses the expression through active raising and interrogation of Gao Shami's answer. Tianyin Yuanxiu independently deploys it through independent direct adaptation contrasting withered and thriving.
